RUN4_ACCEPTED_TECHNICAL_PRIVATE_MASTER.use: reference for sync, edit, and picture parity; fallback source if the Resolve rebuild fails parity

GEMINI_INTELLIGENCE.protected_window_note: The requested window 03:25-03:35 runs past the audio end (214.4s), so it is clamped to 205.0-214.4s.

input_bindings.binding_rule: Before any work starts, re-hash every input. Stop if any hash does not match the values above.

reuse_from_RUN4: A/V sync offset between RAW and MASTER2 (read from the RUN4 project or edit decision; do not re-derive by ear)
head trim and tail trim decisions
color treatment, if one was applied in RUN4 (otherwise leave RAW color untouched)
encode settings that produced the accepted RUN4, as the baseline for the review proxy
do_not_reuse: RUN4 encoded pixels as the source for new renders while the RAW rebuild is available (avoids generational loss)
any lyric or caption assets (none exist; none may be created)
accepted_reuse.fallback: If the RAW+MASTER2 rebuild cannot reach parity with RUN4 (see technical_qc_plan.parity_vs_RUN4), stop. Nitin decides whether RUN4 itself becomes the source for derivatives and stills. Claude does not make that switch on its own.

project_settings.image_scaling: Scale entire image to fit; mismatched resolution = center crop with no resizing (should never trigger, because the source is already 1080x1920)

steps.action: Import RAW and MASTER2 read-only. Confirm clip attributes: 1080x1920, 30fps, 48k stereo.
Create timeline AAKHRI_MASTER_V01. Place MASTER2 on A1 at 00:00:00:00, with no gain, EQ, dynamics, or fades on the full-length master (clip gain 0.0 dB, track fader 0.0 dB, bus fader 0.0 dB).
Place RAW on V1 using the RUN4 sync offset. Trim the RAW tail so the video ends at the audio end: 6432 frames, 214.4s. The ~3-frame video overhang is discarded.
Frame lock: Inspector Zoom 1.000, Position 0/0, Rotation 0, no crop. No horizontal recrop at any time.
Subtle push-ins, only inside the impact windows, as uniform centered zoom keyframes (Inspector Zoom, X and Y linked, anchor at frame center, Position 0/0):

keyframes.return: cut back to 1.000 on the first frame after the window only if it lands on a natural pause; otherwise ease back over >= 60 frames starting at 01:07:00
ease back to 1.000, reaching it no later than 03:24:29

hard_limits.note: At 1.04 zoom, about 3.8% of the frame edge is lost on every side, uniformly. The aspect ratio is unchanged. Before locking, confirm the performer's head and hands stay fully inside the frame on the timeline.

steps.action: Grade: none beyond what RUN4 used. No LUTs, stylization, vignettes, grain, or beauty filters.
Fusion title/artist labels per fusion_graphics_plan (master placements only).
Render a mezzanine and a review proxy (see outputs).

master_execution_plan.storage: Local private folder only. No upload to Drive, Make, Sheets, YouTube, or any social platform.

common.source: AAKHRI_MASTER_V01 timeline, clean (no labels), in new compound or sub-timelines. Labels are added per derivative in Fusion.
common.frame: 1080x1920, 30fps, no recrop; uniform zoom <= 1.04 is inherited from the master and nothing is added on top
common.audio: MASTER2 segment. Fade in over 6 frames (200 ms) and fade out over 9 frames (300 ms) to avoid clicks. No other processing.
outputs_per_derivative: H.264 review proxy, same spec as the master review
common.cut_point_rule: Cut on the exact timecodes given. If the eye check finds a cut mid-syllable, you may move either boundary by up to ±15 frames to the nearest breath or phrase gap. Log the adjusted in/out frames in the sidecar.

fusion_graphics_plan.node_graph: MediaIn1 -> Merge1(Background) ; Text+ (T_TITLE) -> Transform_T -> Merge1(Foreground) -> Merge2(Background) ; Text+ (T_ARTIST) -> Transform_A -> Merge2(Foreground) -> MediaOut1

styling.font: one neutral sans-serif whose license is confirmed for this use; FONT_LICENSE_UNVERIFIED blocks the render
styling.legibility_aid: Text+ Shading element 2 (soft shadow): black, 35% opacity, softness 8, offset 0/2 px. No boxes, bars, or plates.

placement_and_safe_zones.label_block_anchor: bottom-left of the permitted area, baseline at y ≈ 1500, x starting at 72
placement_and_safe_zones.face_exclusion: The label block must not intersect the performer's face or hand bounding boxes on any frame where it is visible. If it would, move it upward within y 1300-1500, or drop the artist line.

master.reason: first unprotected moment after the 00:03-00:15 protected opening
minimal text; no end card, because 03:25-03:35 is protected

timing.animation: opacity 0 to 90% over 12 frames, hold, 90% to 0 over 12 frames. Allowed Y drift ≤ 8 px. No scale pops, no kinetic type.

performer_visibility_constraint.requirement: >= 80% of the performer's bounding-box area left unobscured on every frame
performer_visibility_constraint.design_margin: The label block is kept to ≤ 5.1% of the frame and placed away from the face. Expected obscured share of the performer box is ≤ 8%. This is an estimate; QC must measure it.
performer_visibility_constraint.push_in_note: Uniform zoom ≤ 1.04 does not count as obscuring, but any performer area pushed out of frame counts as lost visibility and is measured the same way

stills_plan.source: clean master timeline (no labels), rendered from the mezzanine timeline, not grabbed from the H.264 file

stills.search_window_frames: ±10; choose the sharpest frame with open eyes and no motion blur

stills_plan.format: PNG, 1080x1920, 8-bit RGB, Rec.709, no text overlay, no crop
stills_plan.log: Record the chosen frame numbers and their offset from the target in the sidecar.
stills_plan.status: private review stills; not posters (FIRST_REAL_POSTER remains PAUSED_BY_NITIN)

captions_metadata_plan.lyric_captions: NONE. Lyrics and translations are unavailable, and none may be invented, transcribed from audio, or machine-generated.

fields: sync offset used (frames) and its source (RUN4)
derivative in/out frames as actually rendered, plus any ±15-frame adjustments with reasons
still frame numbers as actually rendered

embedded_metadata.title: AAKHRI_MASTER_V01 / AAKHRI_D#_V01 (working names only)
embedded_metadata.forbidden: no publishing descriptions, hashtags, credits, ISRC, copyright lines, or rights claims

container_and_stream_checks: ffprobe: width 1080, height 1920, SAR 1:1, r_frame_rate 30/1, avg_frame_rate 30/1 (CFR), pix_fmt yuv422p10le (ProRes) or yuv420p (H.264), color_primaries/trc/space bt709
master duration 6432 frames ±0; each derivative 450 frames ±0 (or the logged adjusted length)
audio 48000 Hz, 2 channels; ProRes mezz PCM 24-bit
audio_integrity: Mezzanine: decode PCM, align to MASTER2 at sample 0, and compare. Expected bit-identical, or a maximum absolute sample difference of 0 at 24-bit. Any difference fails the check.
Review proxy: integrated loudness and true peak are measured and logged (EBU R128). They are not normalized and not enforced, because the proxy only needs to match the master's sound.
Derivatives: confirm fade lengths and that no clicks appear at the cut points
technical_qc_plan.sync: A/V offset versus RUN4 at the checkpoints 00:35, 01:56, 02:37, and 03:28. Pass if within ±1 frame (33 ms) at every checkpoint.
parity_vs_RUN4: Frame-matched comparison on unlabeled, un-pushed segments (for example 00:03-00:15 and 03:25-03:34). Pass if SSIM ≥ 0.98 and PSNR ≥ 38 dB versus RUN4.
The hash is expected to differ from RUN4 (new render), so hash equality is not a criterion
technical_qc_plan.frame_integrity: No dropped or duplicated frames (ffmpeg framemd5 on the mezzanine versus the timeline frame count; freezedetect with no unexpected freezes over 0.5 s).
framing: Aspect ratio 9:16 on every frame. No horizontal recrop. Zoom ≤ 1.04, confirmed from the Resolve keyframe export.
Protected windows (00:03-00:15, 03:25-end): zoom exactly 1.000 and zero overlay pixels (difference against the clean render equals 0 inside these windows).

performer_visibility_measurement.method: Run person segmentation or a bounding-box detector on every 5th frame of each labeled segment. Compute the share of the performer mask covered by any label pixel with alpha > 0.1, plus the share pushed out of frame.
performer_visibility_measurement.pass: unobscured ≥ 80% on 100% of sampled frames; target ≥ 92%
performer_visibility_measurement.fallback_if_no_detector: Manual check on every label-visible second (about 5 frames per second) by drawing the face and hand boxes. Log it as MANUAL.

technical_qc_plan.text_audit: OCR every labeled frame. The only strings allowed are the two confirmed labels. Any other text fails the check.

independent_qc_handoff.recipient: an independent reviewer (for example Codex for technical checks and a Gemini session separate from db14b325064aab1b for perception checks). Must not be the same agent instance that rendered the outputs.
package: all output files plus their sha256 values
the input sha256 values listed above (not the input files, unless the reviewer needs them for the audio-integrity test)
this plan (CLAUDE_AAKHRI_PRODUCTION_TRANSLATION_V01) as the acceptance reference
reviewer_instructions: Re-hash everything; any mismatch means REJECT
Re-run every technical_qc_plan check without trusting the renderer's logs
Blind perception check: impact windows feel intact, protected windows are clean, each derivative starts and ends on a musically natural point, and the labels never compete with the face
Return PASS, PASS_WITH_NOTES, or REJECT per output, with frame-level evidence
independent_qc_handoff.prohibition: The reviewer may not publish, upload, share externally, or edit the outputs

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All input hashes match the bound values at render time
Mezzanine audio bit-identical to MASTER2 after alignment
A/V sync within ±1 frame of RUN4 at all four checkpoints
Parity with RUN4 on clean segments: SSIM ≥ 0.98, PSNR ≥ 38 dB
Exactly 4 derivatives, each 450 frames (or a logged adjustment of ≤ ±15 frames per boundary), matching D1-D4 in the plan
Exactly 3 stills within ±10 frames of 00:35, 01:56, and 03:28, clean and uncropped
Performer ≥ 80% unobscured on every sampled frame
Protected windows: zoom 1.000 and zero overlay pixels
OCR finds only the confirmed title and artist labels; no lyric text anywhere
Zoom ≤ 1.04 and no recrop, confirmed from the keyframe export
Sidecar complete; all output hashes recorded
Independent QC returns PASS or PASS_WITH_NOTES for every output
All outputs remain in local private storage; no external transfer occurred
